contract:
OWNED BY onboarding B16; the org-following static search (:6395-6412) also edits this file. Fold in. The desktop profile CARD gets no Edit control of its own: cards open the viewer (click delegation :5850-5862), where E6 puts Edit. Wrap post text so it can be swapped: - In `_profileMapDbRow` (:8430-8452) and `_publishProfilePostLocal` (:5998-6016), build the body as `${bodyText}` + media. - In `_profileMapDbRow`, date becomes `_formatRelativeDate(row.created_at) + (row.edited_at ? ' · Edited' : '')`. NEW listener (next to `_profilePrefillFromCard` :5768): `window.addEventListener('vibe:post-edited', (ev) => { … })`. For each `#profilePostsList .profile-post-card[data-post-id=""]`: - `.ppost-body .ppost-text` innerHTML becomes `_esc(content).replace(/\n/g,'
')`. For a legacy cached card with no `.ppost-text`, rebuild the body as that span plus the outerHTML of existing direct img/video children. - Set `.ppost-tags` innerHTML from `tags.map(t => '#' + _esc(t) + '')`; create the `.ppost-tags` div after the readmore button if missing, or remove it when there are no tags. - Append ' · Edited' to `.ppost-date` if it isn't already there. - Call `_measureReadMore(card)`. Then: - `populateAllGrid()` (:5806; it rebuilds the All feed from list clones) - if `id === profilePinnedId`: `profilePinnedId = null; pinFromProfile(id)` (programmatic restore, no btn; :5559) - `savePostsToStorage()` (:8262; a no-op in viewer mode) All content goes through `_esc`; never insert detail.content as HTML. DEPENDS ON E6 (the event) and E1 (edited_at in /api/me/posts).
acceptance: Desktop own /profile: edit a post in the viewer, close it. The card in Posts and the clone in All show the new text, tags and " · Edited" with no reload; the pinned slot updates if that post is pinned.
Reload: the card still shows the new text (from /api/me/posts) and " · Edited".
Extract the inline scripts and run `node --check` on them (same method as the plan's messages.html check).
A post whose new content contains renders as text on the card.
